title: 天堂私服 | GM指令分析 (贈送)「L1J版」

account=* targets all accounts
article warns the parameter order shown by old code help is wrong and gives the corrected order
L1DwarfInventory.present selects accounts, checks item existence/stackability, and writes character_warehouse

character_warehouse fields shown include id, account_name, item_id, item_name, count, is_equipped, enchantlvl, is_id, durability, charge_count, remaining_time, last_used, bless, attr_enchant_kind, attr_enchant_level, firemr, watermr, earthmr, windmr, addsp, addhp, addmp, hpr, mpr, m_def

project_relevance: warehouse insertion vs live inventory refresh
verify: whether direct DB/storage mutation requires relog or explicit refresh
